'''Ession's primary moon''' was the primary [[Moon/Legends|satellite]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ession]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Its surface was rocky, barren, and dusty. [[Wraith Squadron]] used the moon's surface as cover for their commandeered corvette [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']] during the [[Battle of Ession]] by using [[tractor beam]]s to raise a dust cloud for concealment from the [[Star Destroyer]] [[Implacable (Star Destroyer)/Legends|''Implacable'']]. A relay dish on the moon's surface was also used to jam the Star Destroyer's sensors. ''Implacable'' ultimately fell prey to the Wraiths' assault and crashed into the moon with heavy casualties.
